title: On Letting the children go unaccompanied
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：let　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 let 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the painter ① let the children go unaccompanied at once, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② lets the children go unaccompanied in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ let the children go unaccompanied at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ let the children go unaccompanied before — a line in the catalogue for May 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Letting the children go unaccompanied at once, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ let the fire out before bed in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Let the fire out before bed at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ lets the fire out before bed at once every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ let the children go unaccompanied again when nobody else would.

⑩ To let the children go unaccompanied, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody lets the children go unaccompanied in the rain again and somebody must let the children go unaccompanied at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 让（一般过去式 let the children go unaccompanied：1987 年画师头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 让（一般现在 lets the children go unaccompanied：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 让（不定式 to let the children go unaccompanied：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 让（过去完成时 had let the children go unaccompanied：1981 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 让（动名词 letting the children go unaccompanied 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 放出（let the fire out before bed：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去放出睡前把火弄灭）
G. v. 放出（let the fire out before bed：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 让（后段两处：新来的观者照例 lets the fire out before bed，而母亲又一次 let the children go unaccompanied）

answers.why: let 意为“让”，1987 年画师二话不说地让让孩子们独自去，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 let。
let 意为“让”，自那以后画师淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 lets。
let 意为“让”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯让让孩子们独自去”，此处为不定式 to let the children go unaccompanied。
let 意为“让”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人让过，故用过去完成时 had let。
let 意为“让”，画师说“让让孩子们独自去这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 letting the children go unaccompanied 作主语。
let 意为“放出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去放出睡前把火弄灭”，should ever 之后用原形 let the fire out before bed。
let 意为“放出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻放出睡前把火弄灭（let the fire out before bed at once），以后再也不要提起。
let 意为“让”，新来的观者每个季度都照例放出睡前把火弄灭，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 lets。
let 意为“让”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地让让孩子们独自去，用一般过去式 let 叙述。
let 意为“让”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要让让孩子们独自去，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 let 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the painter let the children go unaccompanied at once, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter lets the children go unaccompanied in the rain whenever the studio asks.
Letting the children go unaccompanied at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever let the fire out before bed in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio lets the fire out before bed at once every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother let the children go unaccompanied again, and the studio remembered that half.
